def odd_count(lst):
    result = []
    for s in lst:
        n = sum(1 for ch in s if int(ch) % 2 == 1)
        template = "the number of odd elements in the string i of the input."
        # str.replace replaces every 'i', including those inside "in", "string", and "input".
        # The doctest expects this, so it is intentional.
        result.append(template.replace('i', str(n)))
    return result
